items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee sings a song titled 'Domino Shine' and explains the origin of the nickname, but does not state a personal relationship with a person by that name.

ctx.x:
sang to you.
"What is there about me that
Makes me feel well dressed
The same old clothes, shoes and hat
The same old things rearranged,
And it's very plain to see
Just how it happened to be.
I put some polish on my sky piece
I made a shoestring into a tie
I cut the corners off the end of my coat
So they wouldn't fly
I got my shirt from a silver lining
I made my cane from an old oak tree
And that is just the reason why
The folks all nicknamed me.
Just because -- my hair is curly
And because -- my teeth are…

So I did a strut to that,
you know. Duke Ellington's band was playing
and I was going to strut to that and I strut
up the stairs and I turned before the mirror
and everything -- see, I'm going up to get
Rochester who's upstairs and I'm going up to
the gambling room to get Rochester on on
account of him getting Lena Horne, taking her
